The mixture of the calculated metal powders was then subjected to a tubular mixer for 8 h to ensure even distribution.
Finally, the mixture was compacted into blocks by the tablet machine.

The block samples were inserted into the arc melting furnace and high purity argon gas was injected into the chamber to obtain a more inert atmosphere. Melting was carried out in a copper crucible and the buttons were flipped over 5 times to improve chemical homogeneity.
Annealing took place at 400, 600, 800 and 1000◦C for 2 h in a muffle furnace.
